title: Club Activities
content:
# Club Activities

The club runs a comprehensive programme of cycling activities throughout the year, with a regular pattern from week to week. Check the club calendar for the latest dates and times.

## Programme of Activities

- Weekend club rides
- Audax and long-distance rides
- Youth cycling
- Time trials and racing
- Training and skills sessions
- Cyclo-cross, mountain biking and track cycling
- Club nights and social rides

Read the [club route library](/club-route-library/) or visit the [club calendar](/club-calendar/) for current information.

## Risk and Ride Cancellation

Individuals take part in group rides at their own risk. Every rider should decide whether the conditions are suitable and arrive with a roadworthy bicycle, suitable clothing and emergency contact details.

## Participation by Non-Members

Visitors are welcome to try a club ride. Please contact the club in advance if you are unsure which activity is appropriate.

## Preparation

Please bring food, drink, lights when required and the ability to repair a puncture. Club activities depend on volunteers, so members are encouraged to lead rides, marshal and support events.
